data_objects.name: meteorological_time_series
data_objects.meaning: Timestamped meteorological observations for a single, unspecified observing context.
data_objects.notes: The table does not identify the observing location, station, or measurement-system metadata.

variables.name: time
variables.meaning: UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 notation identifying the observation time.

variables.name: sun
variables.meaning: Discrete numeric code for sunshine or sun conditions; the meanings of the code values are not supplied.

variables.name: temperature
variables.meaning: Air-temperature reading at the observation time.

variables.name: chill
variables.meaning: Chill or apparent-temperature reading at the observation time.

variables.name: humidity
variables.meaning: Humidity reading at the observation time.

variables.name: wind direction
variables.meaning: Categorical compass-direction abbreviation for the observed wind direction.

variables.name: wind speed
variables.meaning: Wind-speed reading at the observation time.

variables.name: visibility
variables.meaning: Visibility reading at the observation time.

variables.name: air pressure
variables.meaning: Atmospheric-pressure reading at the observation time.

structure.description: Each row is one time-stamped bundle of meteorological readings, and time is a candidate row identifier.
Rows are stored in ascending UTC time. Neighboring observations generally use ten-minute increments, with larger gaps also present.
All measurement columns in a row align to the same timestamp. Empty CSV cells encode unavailable readings.

uncertainties: No units are declared for the numeric weather readings, so their units remain unspecified.
The sun codebook and the language or notation used by the wind-direction abbreviations are not defined.
The location, station identity, and whether chill is a measured or derived quantity are not established.
annotation_notes: Semantics are grounded only in the declared train.csv evidence.
